Terms

These terms of use cover the Veylet Capture app and the Veylet Studio service, for Veylet Studio (Australia). Last updated 23 September 2026. Applying, requesting a walkthrough or completing a first sign-in when account access is available (which creates the email account) is not approval, a booking or a paid contract. This is not legal advice.

Capturing and sharing a space. You must have permission to capture and share a space, and you must hold the rights to anything you upload. Do not upload other people’s private interiors without that permission, and keep street addresses, access codes and identity documents out of Veylet records — the desk rejects an address-shaped location for that reason. Concept imagery on this site is original and AI-generated. It is not a captured property or a client case study.

The free months. An eligible new account gets six free months with four accepted walkthroughs included across them. Eligibility is confirmed when the plan is activated: by Apple for the App Store, or in the studio's written terms for an invoiced account. A walkthrough counts as accepted when the studio check passed and your account approved that exact revision; a capture that was not good enough never counts. Work beyond the four requires your explicit agreement at the extra-walkthrough price on the offer page before it starts. Using the four does not end your trial early or authorise an automatic extra charge. Paid plans include a set number of walkthroughs per monthly allowance window (Solo one, Team three, Office ten), including when you pay yearly; unused allowance does not carry over.

Activating. The free months start when you activate the plan — in the app through the App Store, or through the studio for an account it invoices — not when your first walkthrough is accepted. Activating sets up the subscription: an App Store account in the app, or an invoiced account the studio sets up. Card payment on this website is coming later; until it is available, a plan not started in the app is arranged and invoiced by the studio under agreed terms, and no page on this website collects card details.

Renewal. An App Store subscription renews automatically after its introductory offer at the monthly or annual price shown by Apple before purchase, unless cancelled through Apple. An annual payment is charged in full and covers twelve paid months. Check your renewal date in Settings › Subscriptions. Studio-invoiced plans follow the written billing agreement. Changing a renewal preference does not buy extra capacity or promise an earlier paid start. The offer page shows both channels' published prices.

Cancelling. Cancel any time. If you activated in the App Store, cancel in Settings › Subscriptions on the iPhone or iPad signed in to that App Store account; Apple shows the effective end date, including any effect on an introductory offer. For an invoiced plan, cancel by email to yoda@yodalai.xyz, and we confirm the date the plan ends. Cancelling stops the next charge and nothing else: every walkthrough already released stays live for twelve months after its release whatever happens to the plan, its link and embed keep working, and you can still open and hand it over. Deleting the Veylet account ends its hosting. It does not cancel an Apple subscription; manage that separately through Apple. Cancellation is not required to request account deletion.

Extras and other work. Extra accepted walkthroughs, editing and hosting beyond twelve months are priced on the offer page. They are charged only for work you asked for and we agreed in writing first.

Refunds. A purchase made through the App Store is Apple’s sale. Apple refunds it under its own policy and we cannot refund or reverse it: ask Apple through its Report a Problem page. A charge made on the website is refunded in full if you ask within 14 days of that charge and no walkthrough was accepted in the period it paid for. Nothing here limits your rights under the Australian Consumer Law.

Deleting your account. Ask in the app or on your desk at veylet.com/account. We complete the deletion within 30 days and confirm when it is done. You cannot undo it yourself. When it completes, your account, its spaces and its walkthroughs are removed, every handoff link and embed stops working, and hosting of every released walkthrough ends with them — deletion ends the twelve-month hosting term early, where cancelling the plan does not. Remove the links and embeds from your listing too, because copies people already downloaded cannot be recalled.

What deletion covers. Hosted capture files, generated walkthroughs and the account records used to deliver them are removed. Once removal starts, these files cannot be restored through your account. Copies on your own device, exported files and copies already downloaded by someone else are outside this account deletion. Contact us about any copies held separately by the studio.

Limited records we retain. Invoices, receipts and minimal records of payments, accepted services and deletion may be retained for accounting and legal obligations. These retained records do not provide access to your imagery, captures or walkthroughs. Deleting a Veylet account does not cancel a subscription billed by Apple; manage that subscription in your Apple account.

No promise of work. Veylet does not promise jobs, leads or earnings to operators or to capture partners. Applying is free assessment; it does not create an account, grant app access, take payment or reserve capacity.

Australian Consumer Law. Our services come with guarantees that cannot be excluded under the Australian Consumer Law. Nothing in these terms excludes, restricts or modifies them. For a major failure you are entitled to a refund; where the failure is not major, you are entitled to have the problem fixed within a reasonable time.

GST and currency. Every amount is in Australian dollars. If GST applies it is included in the price shown, and the receipt states the exact treatment. Apple is the merchant of record for App Store subscriptions and remits Australian GST on those sales; Apple’s receipt, not ours, is the tax invoice for them.

Governing law. These terms are governed by the law of Queensland, Australia, and the courts of Queensland have jurisdiction.

Veylet Studio is operated by Yo-Da Lai, a sole trader registered for GST (ABN 84 992 526 369), from south-east Queensland, Australia. Contact: yoda@yodalai.xyz.
